text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder keeps her word during<n>the Asahi
Hai Futurity Stakes. In fact,<n>she outdoes herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The crowd is electric. They all appear<n>to be singing
her praises.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But in reality...

text_block_list.name: Child in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
Wooow... Hey, Dad, was that the new<n>"beast"
lookalike everyone's been<n>talking about?

text_block_list.name: Seasoned Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. That kind of performance<n>reminds me of
Maruzensky when<n>she was in her junior year.

I'll never forget how the crowd<n>roared when she
set that record.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I call a race!Tomorrow's article will practicallywrite itself!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I better get a good picture to go along<n>with it! Oh! I
know! I can pair it with an<n>old picture of
Maruzensky. The<n>readers will eat that up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I should have expected this. In my<n>head, I knew it
was coming.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But now that it's actually happening...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh... pardon me. Everything is fine,<n>Trainer.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's shadow... looms much<n>larger than I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I explored every possible avenue in<n>my
preparations and held nothing<n>back in my pursuit of
victory.

And yet, all they call me is the new<n>Maruzensky. All
they see is an echo<n>of that hotrod-red streak.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I won't stand for it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Following in her footsteps will only<n>keep me
beneath her shadow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In which case, I have but one option.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I must face her directly.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder silently nods, her eyes<n>ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Determination. That is what I swore to<n>uphold.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'd be fortunate to so much as<n>scratch the surface
of her abilities, so<n>we'll have to pull out all the
stops.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That means remaining as diligent as<n>possible
throughout the Classics.

The Japanese Derby in particular is<n>non-negotiable,
as it will determine<n>the face of my generation.
choice_data_list: Sounds like it's our next objective, then!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Where there's a will, there's a way.No matter how grand she may be... Iwill surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Derby has become our<n>first goal in
preparing for a<n>showdown with Maruzensky!
